SELECT 'post' AS targetType, t.target_id AS targetId, p.post_id AS postId, LEFT(p.content, 30) AS preview, p.board_id AS boardId, b.name AS boardName, u.name AS authorName, rs.label AS reasonLabel, t.first_reported_at AS firstReportedAt, t.report_count AS reportCount, r.status AS reportStatus, p.state AS state
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT 'comment' AS targetType, t.target_id AS targetId, p.post_id AS postId, LEFT(c.content, 30) AS preview, p.board_id AS boardId, b.name AS boardName, u.name AS authorName, rs.label AS reasonLabel, t.first_reported_at AS firstReportedAt, t.report_count AS reportCount, r.status AS reportStatus, c.state AS state
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT r.report_id AS reportId, rs.label AS reasonLabel, r.detail AS detail, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.status AS status FROM reports_log r LEFT JOIN reasons rs ON r.reason_id = rs.reason_id WHERE r.target_type = #{targetType} AND r.target_id = #{targetId} AND r.status <> 'rejected' ORDER BY r.created_at ASC, r.report_id ASC
